---
title: "Appendix 1: Special Adapters"
---

Special adapters, built to meet specific needs, are available upon request from clients.

## Vehicle Dashcams

A dedicated adapter is available for **BlackVue** Dashcams.

The adapter is intended to connect in real-time to the BlackVue HTTP service of a specific dashcam. The adapter needs to be configured with the following information:

* Dashcam URL
* Record time (seconds or minutes): defines the duration of the video **chunks** to be generated by the dashcam.
* Resolution (frames-per-second, FPS)

The adapter will configure the dashcam with the required recording time and resolution and start downloading the video chunks.

Along with the video data, the BlackVue device also provides **acceleration** and **GPS** information, which the adapter stores in the corresponding measurements associated with the sensor (a triplet float fields for the acceleration, a pair of float fields for the GPS coordinates).

The adapter has been built for the BlackVue protocol version 2.004, and tested with the dashcam _BlackVue DR750X-1CH Plus_.

## Bluetooth adapter

A Bluetooth adapter is available for our **SmartTrack** devices that manages to provide acceleration data.

The adapter can also be used with any Bluetooth device that exposes data for a specific Characteristic ID in the format of acceleration data. This data should be a 48-bit payload composed of three 16-bit floating-point numbers, representing the acceleration along the x, y, and z axes.
